title: Initialize or adopt a project safely
objective: Extend the working src/install.py bootstrap with coordinated project initialization and adoption, preserving its non-destructive conflict behavior while adding state checkpoints through the planned service contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Integrate the existing safe bootstrap installer with planned state and asset services without regressing fresh, existing-project, provider, dry-run, or idempotence behavior
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-031 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Add adoption inventory and mapping through explicit checkpoints while preserving all project-owned files
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-031 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: workflows/project public behavior described by this task acceptance; installed targets receive the canonical role index and individual guides without repository development history
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
Public interface/dependency notes, deviations and risks
